description: This source file defines functions for mapping OpenGL format and type pairs to internal formats, and validating ES3 formats and their combinations. It is part of the ANGLE project, specifically related to graphics format handling.

methods.name: GetSizedFormatInternal
methods.description: Maps a (format, type) pair to a specific internal format GLenum.

methods.name: ValidES3Format
methods.description: Checks if a given format GLenum is valid in ES3.

methods.name: ValidES3Type
methods.description: Checks if a given type GLenum is valid in ES3.

methods.name: ValidES3FormatCombination
methods.description: Validates if a combination of format, type, and internalFormat is valid in ES3.
